findings.title: SERP source vocabulary absent from agent prompts; rich metadata dropped at persistence boundary
findings.suggested_fix: Option A (low effort): Add a source vocabulary note to buildBroadScanPrompt and buildDeepDivePrompt explaining that dataforseo_serp signals are organic SERP results for the configured BORING_SITES_KEYWORDS queries across BORING_SITES_LANGUAGES locales, and that higher organic_position means a stronger existing-market signal. Option B (higher effort): Extend SignalMemoryRecord schema and scored_signals table with a nullable metadata JSONB column; pass metadata.keyword and metadata.organic_position through indexSignalMemory and persist them. As a partial fix, embed keyword context into canonical_text at construction time in the buildRetrieverQueryText call at live_read_model.ts:741.
findings.why_it_matters: The research agent sees [dataforseo_serp] signals in broadScan (line 135) and deepDive (lines 219, 223) prompts but has no vocabulary to interpret them. It cannot distinguish a rank-1 organic result from a rank-10 one, cannot correlate signals by search keyword or locale, and cannot reason about what SERP placement means as a market signal. The connector collects rich metadata (keyword, country_code, language_code, organic_position, aio_text, paa_entries) but this is dropped at the DB persistence boundary — the .strict() schema at contracts/memory.ts:6 permanently excludes it. The ai_post_scrape enrichment step also receives dataforseo_serp source but its prompt has no SERP vocabulary either.

findings.title: buildInitialConnectors shows 'active' for dataforseo_serp_byo when BORING_SITES vars set but DATAFORSEO_API_KEY absent
findings.suggested_fix: Add dataforseoApiKey to RuntimeEnv (matching exaApiKey/perigonApiKey/xBearerToken) and gate line 468 on it in addition to boringSitesLanguages/Keywords. Alternatively, accept current behavior and document that initial status can show 'active' for up to one refresh interval when API key is absent — connector correctly skips and status self-corrects to 'disabled' post-run.
findings.why_it_matters: Other BYO connectors (exa, perigon, twitter) gate initial status on the typed API key in RuntimeEnv (lines 465-467). dataforseo_serp_byo only gates on boringSitesLanguages/Keywords. If BORING_SITES_LANGUAGES + BORING_SITES_KEYWORDS are set but DATAFORSEO_API_KEY is absent, /v1/connectors returns 'active' until the first daily refresh, then corrects to 'disabled'. Operators and any agent watching connector health see a false 'active' signal. Self-correcting but misleading.
evidence: apps/api/src/runtime/live_read_model.ts:468 — gates on boringSitesLanguages/Keywords only, not DATAFORSEO_API_KEY
apps/api/src/runtime/live_read_model.ts:465-467 — exa/perigon/twitter gate on typed API key fields from RuntimeEnv
apps/api/src/runtime/live_read_model.ts:296 — mapByoStatus: 'skipped' maps to { status: 'disabled', last_run: null }
packages/connectors/src/dataforseo_serp_byo.ts:83-88 — connector correctly guards on DATAFORSEO_API_KEY via evaluateByoGuard; returns { status: 'skipped' } when key absent

findings.title: SERP connector config split across typed RuntimeEnv (boringSites) and raw process.env (credentials/budget/depth)
findings.suggested_fix: Add dataforseoApiKey, dataforseoDailyBudgetUsd, and optionally dataforseoSerpDepth to RuntimeEnv alongside boringSitesLanguages/Keywords (apps/api/src/config/env.ts). This matches the typed approach for other BYO connectors and enables the buildInitialConnectors gate fix. Pass these through the runByoConnectorIngestion call instead of raw process.env.
findings.why_it_matters: runByoConnectorIngestion at line 660 receives process.env (raw) while serpInputs are built from typed RuntimeEnv. DATAFORSEO_API_KEY, DATAFORSEO_DAILY_BUDGET_USD, and DATAFORSEO_SERP_DEPTH stay in raw process.env while boringSitesLanguages/Keywords are typed. Tests or environments that override RuntimeEnv do not affect connector credentials. This inconsistency blocks the buildInitialConnectors gate fix since DATAFORSEO_API_KEY is not accessible as a typed RuntimeEnv field.
evidence: apps/api/src/config/env.ts:66-67 — boringSitesLanguages/Keywords in RuntimeEnv; no dataforseoApiKey
apps/api/src/jobs/ingest_byo.ts:72 — API_KEY_ENV maps dataforseo_serp_byo to DATAFORSEO_API_KEY (read from raw process.env at runtime)

residual_risks: PAA entries (extractPaaEntries, packages/connectors/src/dataforseo_serp_byo.ts:57-73) lack the title/snippet truncation applied to organic results (lines 215-216). PAA data currently flows only into dropped metadata and is not an active injection path. If metadata is later persisted and injected into prompts, PAA question/snippet fields become an untruncated prompt injection surface for adversarial SERP content.

runByoConnectorIngestion is called with raw process.env at live_read_model.ts:660. Any test or staging environment that substitutes RuntimeEnv values will not affect DATAFORSEO credentials or budget limits passed to the connector.
testing_gaps: No test covers the pre-run / post-run status transition: BORING_SITES_LANGUAGES + BORING_SITES_KEYWORDS set, DATAFORSEO_API_KEY absent → buildInitialConnectors returns 'active', first daily refresh returns connector status 'skipped', /v1/connectors then returns 'disabled'. The status flip is load-bearing for operator UX.

No test asserts that dataforseo_serp signals flow through to the input of buildBroadScanPrompt or buildDeepDivePrompt — only connector-level event emission is covered (packages/connectors/tests/dataforseo_serp_byo.test.ts). An integration test from runByoConnectorIngestion through to the agent prompt context would catch future regressions in the signal flow path.
